text_block_list.text:
When I headed to the library to do some 
research――

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It should definitely be in this book... 
The formula summary for this exam's 
scope...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Found it, found it! This is it. Next is――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmhmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Superstring theory after all, is it...? 
Still, if one cannot experiment on it, 
then my, oh my...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Is Tachyon-san studying for the exam 
too?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me she's reading all those 
piled-up books by herself...? That's an 
insane amount of reading...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's not called a genius for nothing, 
huh... Still... I'm not gonna lose to her!

As if competing with Agnes Tachyon, Daiwa 
Scarlet kept stacking up finished 
workbooks and reference books. Several 
hours later――

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My eyes are blinking like crazy... 
My brain's about to burst too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet Tachyon-san read a pile that 
reaches the ceiling and looks totally 
unfazed...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To think I'm reduced to this state after 
barely passing my own height... How 
pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Kukuku, I see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Type 0 string theory, is it...? Now this 
might prove rather intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Tachyon-san is heading back 
already...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she didn't even put her books away! 
...Tch, guess I have to do it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Current State of Unified Field Theory", 
"Quantum Entanglement Observation"... 
...and "Applications of Quantum Field 
Theory"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
None of these books have anything to do 
with our exam whatsoever...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... And here I got all fired up 
competing over nothing... I'm seriously 
such an――

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait, kyaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... I knocked them over... I've gotta 
pick them up...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... what is this...? There're so many 
math formulas I've never even seen 
before... This is Japanese... right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't even tell what it's saying. 
She was reading a book this 
complicated...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it might not have anything to do 
with the exams, but... To be able to read 
multiple books like this, she really is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, there's no way I'm losing to her! 
I gotta study way harder!

After that, Daiwa Scarlet resumed her 
studying, fiercely piling up workbooks and 
reference materials right until closing 
time.
